servinfo.title: Dual Sensor Brake Support Control Module Aiming Adjustment

item.ptxt: When ignition is “ON”, 1M class laser beam in IEC60825-1 standards is irradiated from the dual sensor brake support control module. This laser beam is not harmful to eyes in normal usage. However, without observing the following precautions, an optical impairment or loss of eyesight in worst case may occur.
Using a magnifier etc., do not look into dual sensor brake support control module from a distance within 100 mm (3.94 in.).
To avoid danger of harmful irradiation, never disassemble dual sensor brake support control module.
After removing / installing or replacing dual sensor brake support control module and/or windshield, perform “Dual Sensor Brake Support Control Module Aiming Adjustment”.

attention3.ptxt: Check that font windshield does not have any abrasion around dual sensor brake support control module. If the surface has suffered abrasion, replace the windshield.

servinfo.ptxt: Perform “Dual Sensor Brake Support Control Module Aiming Adjustment” as follows.

s1.ptxt: Perform Vehicle Preparation .
Perform Set Up of Aiming Adjustment Tool .
Perform Aiming Adjustment .
Perform Automatic Adjustment by Driving .
Park vehicle on level surface where no obstacles or reflectors in front of the vehicle in the area of 5.0 m (16.4 ft.) ahead.
Check the lighting switch is OFF.
Adjust air pressure of all tires to specified value.
Remove any load from vehicle.
Clean font windshield and check that there is no adhesion of dirt such as water droplet etc. around the dual sensor brake support control module.

servinfosub.title: Set Up of Aiming Adjustment Tool

item.ptxt: Perform centering of the weight at an accuracy of ± 4 mm (0.16 in.) or less.
Ensure the measurement positioning accuracy is ± 2.5 mm (0.10 in.) or less.

s1.ptxt: Hang a string with a weight (1) from the vehicle front end and rear end and put marks (2) on the ground at each end.

attention3.ptxt: Center of emblem (3) shows center of the vehicle at the front end.

s1.ptxt: Crossing vehicle rear end mark (1) and vehicle front end mark (2), stretch a string to about 2.0 m (6.6 ft.) point in front of the vehicle, and fix the string using adhesive tape or the like.
Put a mark (3) on the string at 1,032 mm (40.63 in.) point from front end of the vehicle.
Crossing mark (1), stretch a string (2) vertically to the vehicle center line and fix the string using adhesive tape or the like.
Print two sheets of aiming target.
Stick aiming targets (1) on a white board (2) positioning them as shown in figure.

attention3.ptxt: For accurate aiming adjustment observe the following points.

item.ptxt: Before sticking the aiming targets, check that the white board surface is clean without soil or letter.
Stick the aiming targets on a plane vertical surface.
Do not use lustrous tape to stick the aiming targets.

s1.ptxt: Set up a white board (1) in front of the vehicle as follows.

s2.ptxt: Hang a string with weight (2) at midpoint of the two aiming targets along the surface on the white board and adjust position of the board so that tip of the weight falls on the vehicle center line (3).

Additionally, hang two strings with weights (4) at each center of aiming targets (5) along the surface and adjust position of the board so that each tip of the weight falls on the line (6) stretched vertically to the vehicle center line.

entry.ptxt: On the line stretched vertically to the vehicle center line

item.ptxt: If C1680 is detected as current DTC, “Aiming Adjustment” cannot be done. In this case, it is necessary to perform troubleshooting for C1680 first.
When “Aiming Adjustment” is completed, dual sensor brake support control module clears the DTC automatically.
When “Aiming Adjustment” is completed, parameter “Aiming Completion Status” on SUZUKI scan tool indicates “Complete”.

s1.ptxt: Connect SUZUKI scan tool to DLC (1) with ignition “OFF”.
Set ignition “ON”.
Check the vehicle condition is as follows.

item.ptxt: Ignition: Kept “ON” for 10 seconds or more
Gear shift lever: “Neutral” (M/T model)
Select lever: “P” or “N” (A/T model)

s1.ptxt: Select “Aiming Adjustment” under “Utility” mode.
Select “Next” in SUZUKI scan tool.

attention3.ptxt: Upon selection of “Next”, measurement of the aiming is started.

s1.ptxt: Input the following values and select “Next”.
After that, follow instructions displayed on SUZUKI scan tool.
If any error code of “Error 1” to “Error 21” is displayed when performing “Aiming Adjustment”, perform the item(s) applicable to the code(s) in the following table.

entry.ptxt: Dual sensor brake support control module internal failure (focal distance error)

item.ptxt: Replace dual sensor brake support control module.
Perform “Aiming Adjustment” again.

entry.ptxt: Camera image center failure (image is deviated from the center)
Aiming target position is abnormal (inputted target position and detected target position disagree)

item.ptxt: Check that the following parameters are correct.
If not, input correct values referring to Step 6).

s1.ptxt: Upon completion of “Aiming Adjustment”, set ignition “OFF” and leave it for 10 seconds.
Perform Automatic Adjustment by Driving .

attention1.ptxt: If you do not select a suitable route and take proper precautions when performing a road test, an accident can occur.

item.ptxt: Select a level road with no traffic to minimize the risk of accident.
Perform the test extremely carefully.
Perform the road test with 2 persons, a driver and a tester.

Precise tuning of camera in “Automatic Adjustment by Driving” is performed based on “Aiming Adjustment”, therefore without completion of “Automatic Adjustment by Driving”, camera may not work normally.
For normal operating conditions of the system, perform “Aiming Adjustment” and “Automatic Adjustment by Driving” as a set.
Depending on the running conditions, “Automatic Adjustment by Driving” requires time to recognize the necessary items such as lane-dividing lines.

s1.ptxt: Connect SUZUKI scan tool to DLC (1) with ignition “OFF”.
Set ignition “ON”.
Check the steering angle sensor is normal.
Select “Running Compensation Status” under “Data List” and check “ON” is displayed on SUZUKI scan tool.
If check result is not OK, perform Aiming Adjustment .
Select “Running Compensation Complete Status” under “Data List” and drive vehicle until the parameter changes to “Complete” in SUZUKI scan tool.
Vehicle driving conditions to accelerate the camera learning for the tuning are as follows.

item.ptxt: Drive vehicle to detect scenery change of the road on both sides
Road: A road not having monotonous scenery
Vehicle speed: Higher than 3 km/h (2 mile/h)
Running time: Approx.10 minutes
Drive vehicle to detect two lane-dividing lines on the road
Road: Straight road with two clear lane-dividing lines on both sides of the vehicle
Vehicle speed: Higher than 60 km/h (37 mile/h)
Running time: Approx.10 minutes
